page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 52 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, this instance allocates one thread per core to ensure dedicated compute performance. The hardware configuration includes 384.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per core, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

A defining characteristic of the ecs.i3.13xlarge instance is its integrated local storage, which consists of 11519 GB of solid-state drive capacity. This substantial local storage volume is bundled directly with the instance, eliminating the latency overhead associated with network-attached block storage. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring robust virtualization efficiency and secure resource isolation for demanding input and output operations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i3.13xlarge offers high resource density by combining a large memory footprint with massive local SSD capacity on dedicated compute cores. This makes it highly suitable for workloads that require high-throughput local storage and substantial memory, such as relational databases, NoSQL data stores, distributed file systems, and large-scale transactional processing. The lack of hardware-accelerated GPUs limits its applicability for deep learning workloads, positioning it strictly as a high-capacity storage and database platform.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance designed for high-throughput, data-intensive workloads. It features 52 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.38 GB per core, and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. A key hardware highlight is the bundled 11519 GB of local SSD storage, which provides low-latency, high-capacity data access directly on the host. Operating under the KVM hypervisor, this instance delivers dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. It is highly suited for large-scale databases, distributed file systems, and transactional processing applications that require a balance of dense local storage and substantial memory capacity.
